notes.title: Untitled Goose Game is out! With two geese!
notes.content:
Oh, hello! Untitled Goose Game is now available! Here are a few little goodies for you to get excited about.

The game is 25% off!
As a launch treat, the game will be available at 25% off for the next two weeks.

Two horrible geese!
Starting today, you can play through the whole game with a friend, in our brand new two-player mode. Your saved progress can be played with either one or two geese, so if you start a game in single player, you can get a friend to join in and help you out (and vice versa, if you and your friend do such a bad job cooperating that you have a falling out and you need to go back to single player).

[previewyoutube=YRcGyzhT24g;full][/previewyoutube]
Remote Play Together is supported!
While two-player mode is local-multiplayer only, we’ve had a good time playing with Remote Play Together, which lets you play local-multiplayer games over the internet. Why not give it a try?

Some delightful little stickers are here!
We’ve teamed up with Gabrielle Genevieve (one of the creators of the upcoming Small Talk) to make some little stickers that you can get from the Steam Points Shop. Express yourself using a beautiful little animation of a goose ringing a bell! Or peeking out of a box! Or lovely Jeremy Fish!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33508932/1947a56ea68ea25483a7699d8e4b8b8c9cc01b82.gif

That’s all for now! Please enjoy our Untitled Goose Game.
